title: Trade Coverage
description: trade-coverage/v2: the document a trade-collateralised event carries, the pledger's declaration that the trade's collateral is assembled: the lines it posted and, for a platform account, what the platform reported when it counted them. A calculation agent declares it for an external basket. The receiver checks the declaration against what arrived and answers with collateral-accepted or an exception on it.

accountStatus.description: The account's status at declaration, as the container or the collateral platform reports it.

coverageRatio.description: Collateral value over liability, after haircuts, as a decimal string.
